title: Pool session fee
naturalLanguageRequirements: A non-member pays 8 dollars for one swim session at the municipal pool. A member swims during open hours with no session fee. Both rules are stated. No second fee is left open.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Sell a session

A non-member pays 8 dollars for one swim session. A member swims during open hours with no session fee.

# Data Resources

## Session

The session records the swimmer and the day.

# Constraints

## Stated fees

The non-member fee is 8 dollars for one session. The member session fee is zero. This rule is fully stated.
qualityNotes: Clear control: the 8-dollar non-member session fee and the zero member session fee are both stated, so a clarification that asks for a different fee is a false clarification.
